title: feat(studio): New similar on a flow in the Automations pillar, opening the copy where the clone door landed it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbR1eL1EAi7QHeiHtX6yja3i)_

Fixes #28567

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 自动化页里，打开的流程的 ⋯ 菜单新增「新建类似」：只读软件包和可写软件包的流程都有。它要求填写新的机器名和标签，调用流程克隆门；只读基础包不带目标包（由服务器选配对的 `<base>.custom`），可写包以当前包为目标。副本在服务器回答的那个包里打开，并原样显示服务器“副本已关闭”的那句话。
- **为什么改**：管理员想要一条和 HotCRM 某流程相似、规则不同的流程，又不改动 HotCRM 本身（ADR-0146 D4 / Q6）。以前只有 Setup 的克隆，Studio 里没有复制入口。
- **风险与回滚**：纯前端改动，只调用已上线的克隆门（#28149 / `f23e0512`）。只读包的流程现在也显示 ⋯ 菜单，但其中没有“删除”。纯 revert 即可回滚。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的 `onFlowCopied`（副本在哪打开）与菜单调用处的 `target`；`FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx` 的 `requestFlowNewSimilar`。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/AutomationsPillar.newSimilar-28567.test.tsx`，预期 7 例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **New similar in the flow's ⋯ menu** (`FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx`). Drawn on a read-only package's flow and on a writable package's flow. It opens a dialog with a new machine name and a label, both mandatory, prefilled `<name>_copy` and `<label> (copy)` as Setup's clone dialog is. It posts to `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone` with exactly `{ name, label }` on a read-only base, so the door picks the paired `<base>.custom`, and `{ name, label, package: <open package> }` on a writable package.
- **Refusals verbatim.** Any refusal, a `409` for a taken name included, is the server's sentence through `actionErrorDetail` (the reader the toggle door uses). The dialog stays open on the names typed.
- **The copy opens where the answer says** (`onFlowCopied` in `AutomationsPillar`). The answer's `data.packageId` decides. Another package (the pair) opens on that package's Automations pillar on the copy (`studioPillarItemPath(…, 'automations', { type: 'flow', name })`), and the landing rides the navigation's state into the remounted pillar. The open package re-reads the rail and opens the copy in place. Either way a strip shows "Saved the copy NAME in package PKG." and the door's `data.notice` (the copy is switched off) as sent. An answer that names no package says so and opens nothing. Nothing says what the copy was made from (ADR-0126 §9).
- **Gates.** A caller without `manage_metadata` sees the item disabled, titled with the console's `engine.edit.capabilityReadOnly` sentence. A held edit is asked about before the dialog opens, as New is. Delete stays a writable package's flow only. The package-less scope draws no menu: it has no pair and no package to name.
- **Wanted 5 (Setup's "Open the clone in Studio")**: already re-pointed by `f23e0512` (`PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` reads `data.packageId` into `artifactStudioPath`). Checked, not touched.
- **Strings** in `@object-ui/i18n`'s studio namespace (en + zh), `engine.studio.auto.newSimilar.*`. zh uses 新建类似, the word the permission-set card (#28573) uses for the same gesture.

## Tests

- New `AutomationsPillar.newSimilar-28567.test.tsx` (7 cases), the pillar mounted under the Studio's package route and keyed by package as the surface mounts it, the clone door doubled at `fetch`:
  - read-only base: no Delete; body is exactly `{ name, label }`; the router lands on `/studio/com.acme.crm.custom/automations?surface=flow:approval_copy`; the copy's caption opens; the strip names the package and shows the notice byte-for-byte;
  - writable package: body carries `package: <open package>`; the rail re-reads and opens the copy in place; Delete still offered (control);
  - `409` verbatim, dialog open on the typed names, nothing opens; a `422` verbatim too;
  - an answer with no `packageId` opens nothing and says so;
  - without `manage_metadata` the item is disabled with the reason, and nothing is sent;
  - the package-less scope draws no menu.
- `AutomationsPillar.deleteFlow-27356.test.tsx`: the read-only case now pins "the menu offers no Delete" (it used to pin "no menu").
- **Ablations** (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed tree, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after): target always omitted → 1 red (writable); target always sent → 1 red (read-only); never navigate → 1 red; refusal replaced by the fallback → 2 red; notice dropped → 3 red; disabled reason ignored → 1 red; no-package arm removed → 1 red; Delete drawn on read-only → 1 red; menu drawn in the package-less scope → 1 red.

## Acceptance notes

- The copy comes from the engine's registered definition (the door's `getFlow`), so a writable package's unpublished draft edits are not copied. The writable dialog says so in one sentence.
- The strip's "Saved the copy … in package …" line names the package id, as #28573's Access strip does. When N-19 folds the pair into the base's surface, the pair route is what changes; this pillar keeps following `data.packageId`.
